Explain a recipe: its semantics and every default it relies on

Source: R/explain.R
recipe_explain.Rd

Renders what a recipe means as prose: each population (index, selection, end, observation coverage, criteria), each variable (reducer, window, missing-value rule, the column class of what it projects), each output (grain, collapse, follow-up, censoring, representation) and the publication roots. Every default the recipe relies on is stated (for example the 730-day follow-up of a survival output without tar, the banded age_group of a baseline output, the unique/drop/drop observation coverage of an indexed population). No counts and no SQL are shown.

Usage

recipe_explain(
  recipe,
  detail = c("summary", "semantics"),
  conns = NULL,
  symbol = "omop"
)

Arguments

recipe

An omop_recipe.

detail

"summary" (one line per node) or "semantics" (every default and rule spelled out).

conns

Optional DSI connections (uses the active OMOP session).

symbol

OMOP session symbol used with conns.

Value

An omop_recipe_explain object: $text (character lines), $selected ("v1" or "v2"), $payload (the selected wire plan), $plan (the normalised plan, or NULL for an offline v1 explanation), $defaults (a data frame of the defaults relied on), $digest (the semantic digest, or NULL when unavailable), $server (per-server explain payloads, when conns is given) and $refusal (why execution on these servers would be refused, if it would). Printing it shows the text.

Details

The plan explained is the plan execution would send (amendment A-14): recipe_explain(), recipe_validate, recipe_preview and recipe_execute share one plan-selection rule and, with conns, the same target capabilities. A language-2 plan is explained from its normal form with its semantic digest. A recipe that executes as its v1 plan is explained from that v1 payload and the legacy rules it relies on; offline its lowered IR and digest are not available (the server lowers it), and its native rendering (recipe_to_plan(version = 2)) is never presented as the executed plan. With conns, each server whose profile publishes omopPlanExplainDS (dsOMOP 2.10.3) receives the selected wire plan and reports its normalised IR, compatibility variants and semantic digest (attached as $server). A server whose profile does not publish it, and a call that fails, is reported by site and changes nothing else. For a v1 plan the IR and digest are taken from the servers that explained it when they agree; otherwise they are reported unavailable ($digest is then NULL). The execution route on these servers (the publication protocol, the legacy call of a federation with an older server, or a refusal) is stated, and a recipe they could not execute is still explained, with the refusal reported.

With connections, a matching last-successful-publication receipt reports permitted conflicts, chosen labels and versions. It uses only the factor metadata already admitted for each retained component; explain does not query category occurrence. Before publication those names are unresolved.

See also

recipe_lint, recipe_to_plan

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
recipe_explain(recipe, detail = "semantics")
} # }
